name: arc_easy
description: The ARC Easy (arc_easy) partition is the easier subset of the AI2 Reasoning Challenge (ARC), measuring a model's ability to answer multiple‑choice, grade‑school science questions that require basic factual knowledge and simple reasoning. It evaluates how well models retrieve and apply elementary science concepts to select the correct answer among several options. Questions are short, typically fact-based, and designed to be solvable with common-sense or curriculum-level knowledge.
reputation: Widely used benchmark for measuring elementary science question answering and reasoning; a standard dataset in NLP/ML research on commonsense and science QA.
